PILLALAMARRI · MAHABUBNAGAR
OUR ROOTS. OUR RESPONSIBILITY.

Strong roots.
Ever-growing care.

The spreading canopy of Mahabubnagar’s Pillalamarri banyan is our inspiration: a place of shelter, connection and enduring strength.

That spirit shapes the SVS identity. Each institution is a branch with its own purpose, connected by the belief that education and compassionate care grow together.

Meet the SVS community →
